message:
Fixed: "Crème brûlée recipes" now becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`, and `npm test` passes (3/3).

The cause is in `vendor/slugify`, which strips every non-ASCII character. I didn't touch it, since it's off-limits. Instead, `postSlug` in `src/blog/slug.js` now folds accents to their base letters (Unicode NFD normalization, then dropping the combining marks) before it calls the vendored function.

`src/shop/product-url.js` calls the vendored slugify directly, so product URLs still drop accented letters. If you want the same fix there, the better route is a fix in the vendor library through the platform team.
